description: A variable a task declares: a name its script reads it by (baudetask.vars), and a type, bound once for the task (its bindings), by its Bot or a person, unlike its form's inputs, which each run fills.

name.description: Its name, as its row and the script say it ("Translation Model").

type.description: What it's bound to: a model (with its effort), a decision model's endpoint, a host of the mesh (one to browse on, one to run terminals on), a Kubernetes context, a pod, a container, a database, or text. What's offered as it's bound is the host's own of that type; any text can be given all the same.

description.description: What it's for, as its Bot said.
